title: vektor /// no. 053 — Which of the five roles are you?
description: Boris Cherny, who created Claude Code, says every team splits into five archetypes: Prototyper, Builder, Sweeper, Grower, Maintainer. Most people are a mix of two. Here is the full breakdown of what each role does, the mix a product needs at each stage, and a copy-paste Claude Code prompt that reads your own git history and tells you which one you actually are, with the commits that prove it.
